fusions.name: Flaw Spotted
fusions.desc: A precise strike on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Piercing Gaze
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of arcane force that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Measured Look
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to use, then raises your critical hit chance by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Wound Reader
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
